title: Native capture
description: Lossless record of what a real device emitted. Raw measurements are stored; digests are derived off-device. Every probe carries its own success state so a failure can never be mistaken for a measurement.

context.description: Provenance. A capture without this is not evidence.

label.description: Human name for the device, e.g. 'apple-m4-max'

collector_sha256.description: Hash of collector.js that produced this. Captures from different collector versions are not comparable.

headed.description: Whether a real window was on screen. Null when undeterminable.

automation_suspected.description: True if any automation-shaped signal was present (navigator.webdriver, CDP artifacts, headless UA token). A capture with this set is not T0.

probes.description: One entry per measured surface, keyed by probe id.

repeat.description: Second reading of every deterministic probe, taken in the same session. Divergence here means the field is not stable on real hardware and cannot be treated as a fixed value.

ok.description: False means the probe failed. `value` is then null and `error` explains. Never substitute a plausible value.

value.description: The raw measurement. Any JSON type. Null when ok is false.

error.description: Exception message or reason the probe could not run.

encoding.description: How `value` is stored. Binary payloads are base64 so nothing is lost to JSON number coercion.
